description: You are preparing a PR for a web scraping library you've been developing. Your tech lead requires all technical debt markers (TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX comments) to be documented before merge. Your task: (1) Use VSCode's search feature (Ctrl+Shift+F) to find all TODO, FIXME, HACK, and XXX comments across the project in /home/ga/workspace/web_scraper/, (2) Create a file named TECHNICAL_DEBT.md in the workspace root directory (/home/ga/workspace/web_scraper/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md), (3) In this file, document each technical debt marker grouped by priority: CRITICAL (blocks merge), HIGH (fix soon), and MEDIUM (track for later), (4) For each item include: the file path (e.g., scraper/core.py), line number, the marker type (TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX), and a description of the issue, (5) Use markdown formatting with headers for each priority level, (6) Focus on identifying high-impact issues like the XXX comment about relative URLs and the FIXME about rate limiter blocking, (7) Save the file when complete. The workspace contains a web_scraper project with files in scraper/ and tests/ directories containing various technical debt markers.
